fields: L6 Hong Kong / Mid-Autumn Festival (inline roller skates; Central → Victoria Harbour → The Peak). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4 / L5. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 月饼摊 Mooncake Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh must equal choices; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12 where CJK=1, ASCII=0.5), peak_final = The Peak / 太平山顶 final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational, no bare arithmetic). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Peak final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 中秋谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L5 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: 维港边有 7 支叮叮车，每队有 7 名乘客，一共有多少名乘客？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the harbour, 20 festival lanterns are shared equally by 4 trams. How many does each team get?
questions.q_zh: 在维港，20 盏节日灯笼平均分给 4 支叮叮车，每队几面？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 35 mooncakes sit on the trays at the Peak, and 3/5 of them are sweet bean. How many mooncakes are sweet bean?
questions.q_zh: 太平山托盘上有 35 块月饼，其中 3/5 是豆沙馅，豆沙馅的有多少块？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A rectangular mooncake stall at the Peak is 19 dm long and 4 dm wide. Flora ties lantern string once around its edge. How many decimetres of thread does she need?
questions.q_zh: 太平山一个长方形月饼摊位长 19 分米、宽 4 分米。Flora 用灯笼线沿边绕一圈，需要多少分米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A welcome mat at the Peak lookout is 12 m long and 11 m wide. What area does it cover in square metres?
questions.q_zh: 太平山观景台的迎宾地毯长 12 米、宽 11 米，面积是多少平方米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora skates 8 km from Central to the harbour, then walks 150 m along the railing. How many metres does she travel in all?
questions.q_zh: Flora 从中环滑 8 千米到维港，又沿栏杆走了 150 米，一共走了多少米？
questions.qtype_zh: 单位换算（米↔厘米、千克↔克）
